2026-11-13-gaza-1.statement: The Gaza Ministry of Health reports that 1,800 or more Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect.
2026-11-13-gaza-1.resolution: Yes if a Gaza Health Ministry figure, as reported by Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP or OCHA, published on or before 2027-01-31, gives a post-ceasefire death toll of at least 1,800.

2026-11-13-lebanon-1.statement: Israel carries out an air strike on Beirut's southern suburbs (Dahiyeh).
2026-11-13-lebanon-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera or L'Orient Today report an Israeli air or drone strike hitting Beirut's southern suburbs between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-iran-1.statement: The United States and/or Israel strike targets on the Iranian mainland away from the Hormuz coast and islands (e.g. Tehran, Isfahan, Natanz, Fordow, or other inland sites).
2026-11-13-iran-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report a US or Israeli strike on a site in an inland Iranian province (not Hormozgan, Bushehr coast or the Gulf islands) between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-iran-2.statement: The United States and Iran publicly announce an agreement or framework to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping.
2026-11-13-iran-2.resolution: Yes if both governments, or the mediating state (Qatar/Oman) with both sides confirming, announce an agreed arrangement for reopening Hormuz, as reported by Reuters or AP, by 2027-01-31.

2026-11-13-yemen-1.statement: Yemeni government forces open a land route into Taiz city, breaking the Houthi siege.
2026-11-13-yemen-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera or OCHA report that government forces have reopened a road into Taiz city allowing civilian or aid traffic, by 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-israel-1.statement: A new Israeli government headed by Gadi Eisenkot wins a Knesset confidence vote and is sworn in.
2026-11-13-israel-1.resolution: Yes if Times of Israel, Haaretz, Reuters or AP report that the Knesset approved a government with Eisenkot as prime minister by 2027-01-15.

2026-11-13-iraq-1.statement: A drone or rocket attack targets the US Embassy in Baghdad or the US consulate in Erbil.
2026-11-13-iraq-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Shafaq News or Rudaw report a drone or rocket attack aimed at (including intercepted over) the US Embassy in Baghdad or the US consulate in Erbil between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-saudi-arabia-1.statement: A single Houthi missile or drone attack on Saudi territory kills five or more people.
2026-11-13-saudi-arabia-1.resolution: Yes if Saudi authorities, Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report at least five deaths from one Houthi attack (including interception debris) on Saudi territory between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-jordan-1.statement: Another attack inside Jordan that authorities describe as terrorist kills at least one person.
2026-11-13-jordan-1.resolution: Yes if Jordanian authorities (Public Security Directorate/Petra), as reported by Reuters, AP, The National or Asharq Al-Awsat, attribute a fatal attack on Jordanian territory to terrorism between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-libya-1.statement: Armed clashes between rival groups in Zawiya or Surman kill three or more people in a single episode.
2026-11-13-libya-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, Libya Observer, Libya Security Monitor or UNSMIL report at least three deaths from one episode of armed clashes in Zawiya or Surman between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-ukraine-1.statement: Russian forces take full control of the town of Kostiantynivka (Donetsk Oblast).
2026-11-13-ukraine-1.resolution: Yes if DeepState's map or ISW's assessment shows the whole built-up area of Kostiantynivka under Russian control (a Russian MoD claim alone does not count).

2026-11-13-russia-1.statement: Russia and Ukraine carry out a prisoner exchange in which each side releases at least 500 prisoners of war (in one swap or in stages announced as part of the Abu Dhabi deal).
2026-11-13-russia-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or the Kyiv Independent reports that at least 500 POWs per side have been exchanged under the agreement by that date, per official Ukrainian or Russian statements.

2026-11-13-moldova-1.statement: A Russian drone or missile, or identifiable wreckage of one, falls on Moldovan territory (crash or impact, not only an overflight).
2026-11-13-moldova-1.resolution: Yes if Moldova's Defence Ministry or police report a crash, impact or recovered wreckage of a Russian drone or missile on Moldovan territory, as reported by Reuters, AP or Moldovan official channels.

2026-11-13-georgia-1.statement: Georgia's Constitutional Court rules to ban (declare unconstitutional) at least one of the five opposition parties named in the Georgian Dream petition.
2026-11-13-georgia-1.resolution: Yes if Civil.ge, Georgia Today, JAMnews or Reuters reports a Constitutional Court ruling banning at least one of UNM, Coalition for Change, Strong Georgia/Lelo, the Federalists or Gakharia for Georgia by that date.

2026-11-13-mali-1.statement: JNIM attacks a fuel tanker convoy anywhere in Mali in an incident that reportedly kills ten or more people (drivers, escorts or civilians).
2026-11-13-mali-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, RFI or ACLED reports a single JNIM attack on a fuel convoy in Mali on or before 31 Jan 2027 with a reported toll of at least ten dead.

2026-11-13-sudan-1.statement: The Sudanese Armed Forces and allied forces retake the Sali military base in Blue Nile from the RSF–SPLM-N alliance.
2026-11-13-sudan-1.resolution: Yes if Sudan Tribune, Dabanga, Sudans Post, Reuters or AP reports, on or before 12 Feb 2027, that SAF or allied forces have regained control of Sali (an SAF claim corroborated by footage or a second independent source counts).

2026-11-13-chad-1.statement: The Chadian army takes control of the town of Miski in Tibesti from the Miski Self-Defence Committee, by force or under a negotiated handover.
2026-11-13-chad-1.resolution: Yes if AFP, Reuters, RFI or Crisis Group reports on or before 12 Feb 2027 that Chadian state forces control Miski town.

2026-11-13-nigeria-1.statement: ISWAP or Boko Haram fighters attack a military base or forward position in Borno or Yobe in a single attack that reportedly kills ten or more Nigerian soldiers.
2026-11-13-nigeria-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, HumAngle, Premium Times or Daily Trust reports, on or before 12 Feb 2027, a single attack in Borno or Yobe in which at least ten soldiers were killed (military, security-source or credible local tolls count).

2026-11-13-north-korea-1.statement: North Korea launches at least one ballistic missile that South Korea's JCS publicly reports.
2026-11-13-north-korea-1.resolution: Yes if the JCS (as reported by Yonhap, Reuters or AP) announces at least one North Korean ballistic missile launch between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31. Cruise-missile or artillery-only launches do not count.

2026-11-13-myanmar-1.statement: The Arakan Army takes full control of Sittwe, the Rakhine State capital, with junta forces withdrawn or defeated.
2026-11-13-myanmar-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, The Irrawaddy or DVB report by 2027-02-12 that the AA controls Sittwe town and the regime's regional command there has fallen or withdrawn. AA claims alone do not count.

2026-11-13-pakistan-1.statement: Pakistan carries out at least one airstrike or drone strike inside Afghan territory.
2026-11-13-pakistan-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report by 2027-02-12 a Pakistani air or drone strike on Afghan territory, confirmed by Pakistan or reported by the Taliban government. Cross-border artillery or small-arms fire alone does not count.

2026-11-13-taiwan-1.statement: The PLA Eastern Theater Command announces a named large-scale military exercise around Taiwan (in the style of Strait Thunder or Justice Mission).
2026-11-13-taiwan-1.resolution: Yes if, by 2027-02-12, the PLA Eastern Theater Command or Chinese state media publicly announce a drill around Taiwan under a specific exercise name, as reported by Reuters, AP or Taiwan's MND. Unannounced surges and routine 'joint combat readiness patrols' do not count.

2026-11-13-philippines-1.statement: China Coast Guard vessels fire water cannon at a Philippine government vessel (PCG, BFAR or Navy) in the South China Sea.
2026-11-13-philippines-1.resolution: Yes if, by 2027-02-12, the PCG, the AFP or the Philippine NSC report a CCG water-cannon use against a Philippine government vessel, as carried by Reuters, AP or Philippine national media.

2026-11-13-south-korea-1.statement: South Korean troops fire warning shots at North Korean soldiers crossing the Military Demarcation Line.
2026-11-13-south-korea-1.resolution: Yes if the JCS, as reported by Yonhap, Korea JoongAng Daily, Reuters or AP, confirms at least one new warning-shot incident against North Korean troops crossing the MDL between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-31.

2026-11-13-venezuela-1.statement: Venezuela's interim government or the CNE officially announces a specific date for a presidential election.
2026-11-13-venezuela-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or EFE report that the Rodriguez government or the National Electoral Council has formally set a calendar date for a presidential election by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-colombia-1.statement: A single attack by an armed group in Colombia kills five or more soldiers and/or police officers.
2026-11-13-colombia-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, EFE or Colombian national media (El Tiempo, El Espectador) report one incident (one attack or ambush on one day) in which at least five members of the security forces were killed by an armed group, by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-haiti-1.statement: 400 Mawozo leader Wilson Joseph ('Lanmo Sanjou') is killed or taken into custody.
2026-11-13-haiti-1.resolution: Yes if Haitian authorities, the Salvadoran government or the GSF confirm Joseph's death, capture or surrender, as reported by AP, Reuters, the Miami Herald or the Haitian Times, by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-haiti-2.statement: Haitian or Salvadoran authorities confirm the fate (found alive or confirmed dead) of the four Salvadoran aviation technicians missing since 18 October.
2026-11-13-haiti-2.resolution: Yes if the Salvadoran or Haitian government officially states that the four technicians have been recovered alive or that their deaths are confirmed (identified remains included), as reported by AP, Reuters or Al Jazeera, by 31 January 2027.

2026-11-13-cuba-1.statement: Cuba's national electric system (SEN) suffers a total nationwide disconnection (complete grid collapse).
2026-11-13-cuba-1.resolution: Yes if the Ministry of Energy and Mines or the UNE announces a total disconnection of the SEN, as reported by EFE, Reuters, AP or 14ymedio, by 12 February 2027. Partial or regional collapses do not count.

2026-11-13-ecuador-1.statement: President Noboa decrees a fifth curfew of 2026–27 covering at least one coastal province (Guayas, Manabi, Los Rios, El Oro or Esmeraldas).
2026-11-13-ecuador-1.resolution: Yes if an executive decree imposing a new night-time curfew in at least one of these provinces takes effect after 12 November 2026, as reported by Primicias, El Universo, EFE or Reuters, by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-peru-1.statement: Public transport unions in Lima/Callao carry out a strike (paro) against extortion in which a majority of formal bus companies suspend service for at least one day.
2026-11-13-peru-1.resolution: Yes if Peruvian national media (El Comercio, La Republica, RPP, Infobae Peru) or Reuters/AP report a transport strike in Lima/Callao described as widespread or as paralysing most routes, held after 12 November 2026 and by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-19-gaza-1.statement: Israeli strikes or fire kill 25 or more Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on a single day.
2026-11-19-gaza-1.resolution: Yes if the Gaza Health Ministry or civil defence, as reported by Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera or OCHA, reports at least 25 people killed by Israeli attacks within one calendar day (or one 24-hour reporting period) between 2026-11-19 and 2027-02-19.

2026-11-19-yemen-1.statement: The Houthis attack (with a missile, drone, uncrewed boat or boarding) a commercial vessel in the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb or Gulf of Aden.
2026-11-19-yemen-1.resolution: Yes if UKMTO, JMIC, Reuters or AP report an attack on a merchant ship in the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb or Gulf of Aden that is claimed by the Houthis or attributed to them by UKMTO/JMIC or a Western government, between 2026-11-19 and 2027-02-19.

2026-11-19-iraq-1.statement: Iraqi government security forces deploy inside the town of Jurf al-Sakhar (Babil), the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold.
2026-11-19-iraq-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, Shafaq News or Rudaw report that Iraqi army, police or other state forces (excluding PMF units of Kataib Hezbollah itself) have entered and established a presence inside Jurf al-Sakhar town, with or without fighting, by 2027-01-31. A visit by inspection committees alone does not count.

2026-11-19-ukraine-1.statement: A new round of negotiations on ending the war is held in which Russian and Ukrainian delegations both take part (directly or through US-mediated proximity talks) together with an official EU or European-government delegation at the same venue.
2026-11-19-ukraine-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or the Kyiv Independent reports that a negotiating session took place with Russian, Ukrainian and EU (or named European government) delegations present at the same talks by that date. Separate bilateral meetings, such as Europeans meeting only Ukraine or the US, do not count.

2026-11-19-russia-1.statement: Russia reopens the road section of the Kerch (Crimean) Bridge to general vehicle traffic in at least one direction after the 16–17 November 2026 span collapse.
2026-11-19-russia-1.resolution: Yes if Russian official channels (Transport Ministry, Grand Service Express or Crimean authorities), as reported by Reuters, AP, the Moscow Times or Meduza, state that ordinary vehicle traffic has resumed across the road bridge by that date. Rail-only traffic, ferries or a temporary pontoon do not count.

2026-11-19-niger-1.statement: A single armed attack in Niger's Tillabéri region kills 20 or more people (civilians, soldiers or both).
2026-11-19-niger-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, RFI, ACLED or an official Nigerien statement reports, on or before 31 Jan 2027, a single attack in Tillabéri region occurring after 19 Nov 2026 with a reported toll of at least 20 dead (attackers' own losses excluded).

2026-11-19-sudan-1.statement: The Sudanese Armed Forces and allied forces (including the Joint Force) take control of the town of Al-Nahud in West Kordofan from the RSF.
2026-11-19-sudan-1.resolution: Yes if Sudan Tribune, Sudans Post, Dabanga, Reuters or AP reports, on or before 19 Feb 2027, that SAF or allied forces control Al-Nahud town (an SAF claim corroborated by footage or a second independent source counts).

2026-11-19-india-1.statement: A single armed attack, ambush or clash in Manipur kills at least five people.
2026-11-19-india-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, PTI or a major Indian national outlet (The Hindu, Indian Express, NDTV) reports, between 2026-11-20 and 2027-01-31, one incident in Manipur (one attack, ambush or gunfight at one location on one day) with at least five people killed, including militants. Separate incidents may not be combined.

2026-11-19-taiwan-1.statement: Taiwan's MND reports at least 45 PLA aircraft sorties around Taiwan in a single daily (24-hour) report.
2026-11-19-taiwan-1.resolution: Yes if any MND daily 'PLA activities in the waters and airspace around Taiwan' release issued between 2026-11-20 and 2027-01-31 reports 45 or more PLA aircraft sorties, as published by the MND or reported by Focus Taiwan, Taipei Times, Reuters or AP.

2026-11-19-bangladesh-1.statement: Political violence linked to the Awami League protest campaign (clashes, bombings, arson or police fire) kills at least five people in Bangladesh on a single day.
2026-11-19-bangladesh-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, The Daily Star or Prothom Alo report, between 2026-11-20 and 2027-01-31, at least five deaths on one calendar day nationwide in clashes, attacks, arson or security-force fire connected to Awami League protests, lockdowns or Hasina's return, or to reprisals against them.

2026-11-19-venezuela-1.statement: At least one member of Venezuela's armed forces (FANB) is killed in an armed clash with or attack by the ELN or FARC dissidents on Venezuelan territory.
2026-11-19-venezuela-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, EFE, Efecto Cocuyo, El Pitazo or the FANB itself report that at least one Venezuelan soldier or National Guard member was killed by the ELN or a FARC dissident group inside Venezuela between 19 November 2026 and 15 February 2027.

2026-11-19-colombia-1.statement: The Colombian government carries out at least four new aerial bombing operations against armed groups after 15 November 2026 (El Tiempo counted nine under President De la Espriella by that date).
2026-11-19-colombia-1.resolution: Yes if the President, the Defence Ministry or the Military Forces announce or acknowledge at least four new aerial bombing operations conducted between 16 November 2026 and 15 February 2027, as reported by El Tiempo, El Espectador, Infobae or EFE.

2026-11-19-haiti-1.statement: Taliban gang leader Jeff Larose ('Jeff Canaan') is killed or taken into custody.
2026-11-19-haiti-1.resolution: Yes if Haitian authorities, the Salvadoran government or the GSF confirm Larose's death, capture or surrender, as reported by AP, Reuters, the Miami Herald or the Haitian Times, by 15 February 2027.

2026-11-19-bolivia-1.statement: Bolivian police or armed forces launch an operation inside the Tropico de Cochabamba (Chapare) aimed at arresting Evo Morales.
2026-11-19-bolivia-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, EFE or Bolivian national media (El Deber, Los Tiempos, Pagina Siete) report that security forces moved into the Chapare in an attempt to execute an arrest warrant against Morales, whether or not the arrest succeeds, by 15 February 2027.

2026-11-26-lebanon-1.statement: A single Israeli air, drone or artillery strike in Lebanon kills three or more people.
2026-11-26-lebanon-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera, L'Orient Today or Lebanon's National News Agency report at least three deaths from one Israeli strike (one location, one attack) on Lebanese territory between 2026-11-26 and 2027-01-31.

2026-11-26-israel-1.statement: Iran launches ballistic missiles or drones at Israeli territory.
2026-11-26-israel-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Times of Israel or the IDF report at least one Iranian ballistic missile, cruise missile or drone launched from Iran toward Israeli territory (including if intercepted) between 2026-11-26 and 2027-02-26.

2026-11-26-saudi-arabia-1.statement: A Houthi missile or drone attack (including interception debris) causes damage at Jeddah Islamic Port or Jazan port.
2026-11-26-saudi-arabia-1.resolution: Yes if Saudi authorities, the coalition spokesman, Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report physical damage (to facilities, vessels or cargo) at Jeddah Islamic Port or Jazan port from a Houthi attack between 2026-11-26 and 2027-01-31. Unverified Houthi claims alone do not count.

2026-11-26-syria-1.statement: A single attack claimed by or attributed to the Islamic State kills at least five Syrian government soldiers or security personnel.
2026-11-26-syria-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, SANA or SOHR report at least five Syrian government military or security personnel killed in one attack claimed by IS or attributed to IS by Syrian authorities or SOHR between 2026-11-26 and 2027-02-26.

2026-11-26-libya-1.statement: Another drone or missile attack hits a Russian military vessel, aircraft or facility on Libyan territory or in Libyan waters.
2026-11-26-libya-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, Defense News or Libya Observer report a new attack (after 2026-11-22) striking a Russian military ship, aircraft or base in Libya, whether claimed by Ukraine or attributed by Libyan or Russian authorities, between 2026-11-26 and 2027-02-26.

2026-11-26-moldova-1.statement: Moldovan authorities again close all or part of the national airspace to civil aviation because of a drone or missile threat (a closure separate from the 17 November 2026 one).
2026-11-26-moldova-1.resolution: Yes if Moldova's Civil Aviation Authority, Defence Ministry or government announces a new airspace closure or restriction for civil aviation because of drones or missiles by that date, as reported by Reuters, AP, Euronews or Moldovan official channels.

2026-11-26-armenia-1.statement: Armenia's National Assembly adopts a decision to put the draft new constitution to a national referendum (the two-thirds vote required under the current constitution).
2026-11-26-armenia-1.resolution: Yes if Armenpress, Azatutyun (RFE/RL), OC Media or Reuters reports that parliament has voted to submit the draft constitution to a referendum by that date. A government announcement, a draft decision or a vote that fails does not count.

2026-11-26-azerbaijan-1.statement: The Baku Court of Grave Crimes delivers a verdict convicting Popular Front leader Ali Karimli on the charge of attempting to seize power by force.
2026-11-26-azerbaijan-1.resolution: Yes if Turan, APA, 1news.az, JAMnews, OC Media or RFE/RL reports a guilty verdict and sentence for Ali Karimli in this case by that date. Adjournments or an acquittal do not count.

2026-11-26-mali-1.statement: JNIM carries out an armed attack, IED or drone attack inside Bamako district (the capital city itself, not its surrounding region).
2026-11-26-mali-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, RFI or ACLED reports, on or before 26 Feb 2027, an attack inside Bamako district occurring after 26 Nov 2026 that is claimed by or credibly attributed to JNIM (blockade checkpoints outside the district do not count).

2026-11-26-niger-1.statement: A single attack by Boko Haram or ISWAP in Niger's Diffa region kills ten or more Nigerien soldiers or security personnel.
2026-11-26-niger-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, RFI, ACLED or an official Nigerien statement reports, on or before 26 Feb 2027, a single attack in Diffa region occurring after 26 Nov 2026 in which at least ten soldiers, gendarmes or guards were killed.

2026-11-26-burkina-faso-1.statement: A single JNIM attack on a military, VDP or civilian target in Burkina Faso is reported to have killed 20 or more people (attackers excluded).
2026-11-26-burkina-faso-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, RFI, HRW or ACLED reports, on or before 31 Jan 2027, a single attack in Burkina Faso occurring after 26 Nov 2026 attributed to JNIM with a reported toll of at least 20 dead among soldiers, VDP and/or civilians (a JNIM claim alone does not count).

2026-11-26-nigeria-1.statement: A single attack in Borgu LGA, Niger State, kills ten or more people (civilians, herders or security forces).
2026-11-26-nigeria-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, Premium Times, Daily Trust or HumAngle reports, on or before 31 Jan 2027, a single attack in Borgu LGA occurring after 26 Nov 2026 with a reported toll of at least ten dead (official, residents' or community-group tolls count).

2026-11-26-north-korea-1.statement: North Korea conducts a flight test of an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM), as identified by South Korea's JCS or Japan's Ministry of Defense.
2026-11-26-north-korea-1.resolution: Yes if, between 2026-11-26 and 2027-02-26, the JCS or Japan's MoD, as reported by Yonhap, Kyodo, Reuters or AP, assesses a North Korean launch as an ICBM, or KCNA announces an ICBM launch that one of them confirms. Engine ground tests, satellite launches and IRBM or hypersonic launches not classed as an ICBM do not count.

2026-11-26-japan-1.statement: Japan's Ministry of Defense reports a new violation of Japanese territorial airspace by a Russian or Chinese military aircraft or drone.
2026-11-26-japan-1.resolution: Yes if, between 2026-11-27 and 2027-02-26, Japan's MoD or Joint Staff announces that a Russian or Chinese military aircraft or drone (including a suspected one) entered Japanese territorial airspace, as reported by Kyodo, NHK, Reuters or AP. ADIZ entries, close approaches and balloon sightings without an airspace violation do not count.

2026-11-26-indonesia-1.statement: A single attack attributed to the TPNPB/OPM in Papua kills at least three people (civilians or security personnel, excluding attackers).
2026-11-26-indonesia-1.resolution: Yes if, between 2026-11-27 and 2027-01-31, Reuters, AP, ANTARA, Kompas, Tempo or The Jakarta Post report one attack (one location, one day) in Papua attributed by police, the TNI or the TPNPB itself to the TPNPB/OPM that kills three or more people other than the attackers. Separate incidents may not be combined, and deaths of TPNPB fighters in security-force operations do not count.

2026-11-26-bangladesh-1.statement: Sheikh Hasina physically enters Bangladesh (arriving by air or land, whether or not she is arrested on arrival).
2026-11-26-bangladesh-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, The Daily Star or Prothom Alo report that Sheikh Hasina arrived on Bangladeshi territory (including an airport or land port, or in custody) between 2026-11-27 and 2027-01-15. Announcements, travel attempts stopped before entry, or video addresses do not count.

2026-11-26-ecuador-1.statement: The United States and/or Ecuador publicly confirm that joint US–Ecuador military operations against criminal groups, reported paused by the New York Times on 24 November 2026, have resumed.
2026-11-26-ecuador-1.resolution: Yes if the Pentagon, SOUTHCOM, the US State Department or the Ecuadorian government states that joint operations have resumed, or Reuters, AP or the NYT report their resumption, by 26 February 2027. Statements that a 'work plan' merely exists do not count.

2026-11-26-bolivia-1.statement: The Bolivian government reverses or suspends the 24 November 2026 diesel price increase, restoring a pump price below Bs 20.57 per litre.
2026-11-26-bolivia-1.resolution: Yes if a supreme decree or official government/YPFB announcement lowers the regulated diesel price below Bs 20.57 per litre or suspends the increase, as reported by EFE, Reuters, El Deber, Los Tiempos or Unitel, by 31 January 2027. Targeted subsidies or compensation for specific sectors without a lower pump price do not count.
